**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW), confidence 0.9**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 10.5 (p0065) is the only governing-law provision. Targeted searches for "arbitration", "jurisdiction/venue/courts", "dispute resolution" and "New York" returned no other responsive language — there is no foreign arbitration seat and no forum clause at all.
- **Assessment:** New York law satisfies preferred element 1 verbatim, so no change was made to the governing-law wording. The Agreement is silent on forum, so neither the preferred forum element nor the fallback forum element is met — a material gap, not a minor sub-element.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` at p0065 adding exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, with a carve-out only for temporary injunctive relief (which does not defeat the exclusive merits forum). An in-line replace was rejected by the minimality gate, so the insertion is the shortest compliant form; unrelated text and Section 10.5's numbering are untouched.
